evidence: uri_assist/browser_extension/snapshot.js:79-109 clipBoxOf: no mask-image, filter or ancestor opacity, no <details> handling
git show d5a9b41: only R11 patterns added; test HIDDEN_PAGE has no filter/mask/text-fill/details cases

Probe /tmp/diag_D5 (Chromium 1000x900, Ctrl+A): text and selection contain FILTEROPACITY-B, TEXTFILL-C, CPBOTTOM-D, CIRCLE-E, NEARZERO(0.01)-F, MASK-H, POLY-I, CPRIGHT-Q, CP60-R, DETAILS-S; redactions={hidden_text:2}

result.proposed_fix: Change textVisible/visible in snapshot.js so text is dropped unless it is positively shown. Walk the parent's ancestor chain once (cached) and: (1) compute effective opacity as the product of each ancestor's opacity and any filter:opacity(x) value, and treat < 0.1 as hidden; (2) treat any ancestor with a mask-image/-webkit-mask-image other than none as hidden (fail closed, or allow only url() masks); (3) parse clip-path: for inset() read all four sides (percentages against the element's box, px as given) and compute the remaining box, meeting it into clipBoxOf's box; treat circle/ellipse/polygon/path/url shapes as hidden if their area is ~0, otherwise conservatively meet with the element's bounding box; (4) treat -webkit-text-fill-color alpha 0 the same as transparent color; (5) drop text inside details:not([open]) unless it is inside that details' own summary (n.parentElement.closest('details:not([open])') with no closest summary inside it). Use the same function for page text, headings and selection, as now. Add a self-contained Chromium regression test (fixture HTML and node runner embedded and written to tmp_path, asserting not skipping if node/playwright are missing) with the R12 payloads plus kept-visible controls (normal text, opacity:0.5, clip-path:inset(10%), open details, summary text). Check the snapshot's text, selection and headings, and the FakeClient Brain body via mk/grant/ask_and_wait. Update docs/assist/03 line 77 to list exactly what is covered and add the remaining gaps (low-contrast colour, transform scale above the rect threshold, blend modes) to the Not covered list.
result.root_cause: uri_assist/browser_extension/snapshot.js keeps text unless it matches one of a fixed list of known hiding techniques (fail-open). Every check in that list is narrower than the CSS feature it is meant to cover: checkVisibility({opacityProperty}) only catches an element's own opacity:0 (not filter:opacity(), near-zero opacity, or opacity multiplied through ancestors); the clip-path test /inset\(\s*(50%|100%)/ (lines 63 and 87) only matches a leading 50%/100% inset value, so other sides, other percentages and circle/polygon/ellipse shapes pass; textVisible (line 126) checks alpha(color) but never -webkit-text-fill-color; mask-image/-webkit-mask-image are never checked; closed <details> content still returns client rects, so the rect checks (lines 59-60, 132-135) keep it. docs/assist/03 line 77 claims opacity, transparent text colour and clip-path inset are covered and does not list these cases as gaps.
result.why_earlier_repairs_failed: Each repair patched only the techniques named in its own finding. 2de591e (R10-01) only connected the selection to the existing visible() check (shownText); the check itself was unchanged. d5a9b41 (R11-01) added clipBoxOf/covered/alpha(color) for exactly the five R11 patterns (legacy clip, ancestor overflow, text-indent, covering overlay, transparent colour), reused the narrow leading-inset clip-path test, added no opacity, filter, text-fill or mask handling, and widened the docs coverage claim. Its regression test page (tests/assist/test_a0_r11_review_regressions.py HIDDEN_PAGE) contains only the R11 patterns, so it passes (R10/R11 tests: 4 passed) while R12 techniques leak, and the next review finds the next uncovered technique.
